recentItems.title: Istanbul Floods Turn Deadly! 3 Killed, Schools Shut as Landslides and Submerged Roads Disrupt Turkey
recentItems.description:
Istanbul Floods Turn Deadly! 3 Killed, Schools Shut as Landslides and Submerged Roads Disrupt Turkey

Torrential rain has triggered devastating flash floods across Istanbul, leaving at least three people dead and bringing the city to a standstill. Streets were submerged as floodwaters swept cars through neighbourhoods, stranded people and triggered landslides. The heavy downpour disrupted traffic across Istanbul, with several areas facing severe flooding. Authorities are bracing for more rainfall as the situation continues to pose risks to residents and commuters.
